summary: Iteration 40 — Phase-3 verification pass. Backend items 8/9/12/13 all green: 17/17 assertions in test_iteration40_phase3.py. Frontend items 9 & 15 plus 6 regression pages render without an AppErrorBoundary card. Item 15: /inbox correctly hard-redirects to /comm-v2/conversations. Item 9: /ot-calendar/schedule renders with step controls. Item 8: PATCH /api/bookings/{id} status=completed upserts a completed encounter tied to the booking and it appears in /api/encounters/worklist?scope=completed&date=<booking_date>; booking status reverted and test-created encounter deleted in teardown. Item 9 backend: POST /api/surgeries with a scheduling payload works, GET /api/surgeries/conflicts correctly detects overlap and correctly excludes non-overlapping slots, /procedures and /ot-rooms return data; test surgery deleted in teardown. Item 12: /api/drug-repository items[] non-empty and q=para returns matches. Item 13: create → list → re-POST upsert (no duplicate, same template_id) → delete → 404 for missing id, all clinic-scoped under require_staff.
action_items: Optional cleanup: /patients page emits a React 'unique key prop' warning from a VirtualizedList child (does not crash, but worth adding a stable keyExtractor).

Optional cleanup: /dashboard emits a benign 'React does not recognize the %s prop on a DOM element' warning — likely an untranslated debug-format placeholder that leaked to a DOM prop; harmless but worth chasing.
critical_code_review_comments: drug_repository._ensure_global_seed uses a per-process guard (_global_seed_checked) and count-based short-circuit — correct and idempotent; failures are swallowed and won't wedge list requests.

discharge-med-templates upsert key is (clinic_id, name, deleted_at=None) with $setOnInsert on template_id/created_at — safe against duplicates across re-saves, template_id remains stable across upserts (verified).

bookings.PATCH → completed branch upserts by encounters.booking_id and only mirrors when status transitioned; the try/except correctly prevents the encounter mirror from ever blocking booking completion.
surgeries.conflicts filter is scoped to surgery_status in {scheduled,in_progress} and same ot_room+scheduled_date — overlap check works as expected for both hit and miss cases.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only, all cleaned up: (a) 1 discharge-med template TEST_dmt_<uid> — deleted in test_04; (b) 1 scheduled surgery TEST_TURP_SCHED on 2026-02-15 10:00 OT-1 — deleted in test_99_cleanup; (c) 1 confirmed booking PATCHed to completed then reverted back to confirmed and the newly-created encounter row deleted in test_99_cleanup_revert_and_delete.
